faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Zila Panchayat Dhamtari for filling up vacant posts under the department through offline application procedures.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification has been released for the position of लेखापाल across designated categories with a total of 4 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for लेखापाल?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the लेखापाल post distributed across various categories as per government reservation norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the filled offline application form through registered or speed post is 22-10-2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess 55 प्रतिशत में बी.कॉम. (अजजा हेतु 50 प्रतिशत में बी.कॉम.) as specified in the official qualification criteria.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Zila Panchayat Dhamtari लेखापाल recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from a minimum of 21 years to a maximum of 35 years, with age relaxations provided for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the लेखापाल position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of 23350/- एकमुश्त as per the employment terms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode via registered post or speed post to the designated official address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a merit list based on academic percentage and computer practical test weightage along with experience weightage.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form formats directly from the official website at www.dhamtari.nic.in.
